text: Jabir bin `Abdullah (May Allah bepleased with him) reported: Messenger of Allah (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ) said, "Beware of injustice, for oppression will be darkness on the Day of Resurrection; and beware of stinginess because it doomed those who were before you. It incited them to shed blood and treat the unlawful as lawful.'' [Muslim]
